description: Parse a resume / CV (PDF, DOC, DOCX, ODT, PPT, PPTX, ODP, XLS, RTF, TXT, HTML, Markdown, JPG, PNG or BMP, under 4.5 MB) into structured JSON, in resume: contact details, work experience, education, languages, skills and the full resume text in resume.info_resume.text. Give exactly one input: file_path (a local file), file_url (a public URL) or resume_text. HireLayer keeps the resume in the user's resume database under application_id, unless do_not_store_data is set. Takes about 30 seconds. Costs 1 HireLayer credit, 0 for a file already stored.

application_id.description: Your id for this resume, such as the application or candidate id of your ATS (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters). The resume is stored under it, replacing a resume stored under the same id. Omit it when you have no such id: the resume is stored under an id drawn from the file.

do_not_store_data.description: true: HireLayer keeps nothing of this parse and application_id comes back null. Enterprise plan only.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local resume file.

file_url.description: Public URL of a resume file to download.

resume_text.description: Resume as plain text, when no file is available.

workspace.description: The client company this call belongs to, when the user recruits for several companies: its HireLayer workspace id (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters), e.g. acme-corp. Jobs, resumes and scores stay apart from other clients'. A new id creates a new workspace, so reuse the exact id. Omit it for the user's default workspace.

name: parse_resume
title: Resume Parser
